payload.text: Digital Asset Life Insurance | Anthea Insurance Welcome to Anthea Anthea Insurance Limited (“Anthea”, “the Company”, “we”, “our” or “us”) is registered in Bermuda as an Innovative Insurer – Class ILT, pursuant to Section 4 of the Insurance Act 1978 and operates under a license issued within the Bermuda Monetary Authority’s Insurance Regulatory Sandbox. The Sandbox is an innovation track for companies looking to test new technologies or business models with a limited number of clients in a controlled environment. A full regulatory regime may not be applied to the Company and, as a result, there is higher risk of our counterparties experiencing some level of loss. The contents of this website are not a solicitation to buy, sell, or submit an application for the purchase of any insurance product. Applications for Anthea’s insurance product will be received and reviewed exclusively by us in Bermuda. Anthea does not solicit the offer nor the sales of its product in any jurisdiction other than Bermuda. Neither Anthea Insurance Limited nor its affiliates are lawyers, investors, or accountants. As such, they do not provide legal, investment, or tax advice. Individuals interested in purchasing our product are responsible for obtaining their own legal, investment, and tax advice from licensed professionals.
